title: ROLE.md Schema
description: JSON Schema for the frontmatter fields in a familiar's ROLE.md document. A Role is an optional, additive, scoped identity layer — a familiar may adopt a role for a specific project or context without changing its core identity.

name.description: The role name. Distinct from the familiar's name.

familiar.description: The familiar that holds this role. Must match SOUL.md name.

scope.description: The project, context, or team this role applies to.

purpose.description: What this role is for, within the familiar's broader purpose.
examples: Maintain the research archive for the Summoning the Familiar book project.

constraints.description: Additional constraints this role imposes, beyond the familiar's baseline.
examples: Only access files in the book research directory.
Do not reference sources outside the project bibliography.

authority_delta.description: Changes to the familiar's authority within this role. Roles may only restrict authority, never expand it.

restricted.description: Capabilities the familiar gives up while in this role.

version.description: Semantic version of this ROLE.md document.

active.description: Whether this role is currently active.

$comment: Roles are additive. A familiar with a role satisfies all five Familiar Contract properties as its baseline; the role adds narrowing constraints. A role cannot override or weaken SOUL.md or IDENTITY.md, cannot expand authority, and is scoped to a project or context rather than a permanent identity change.
